title: Most of U.S. aluminum comes from Canada. Industry says ‘good luck’ replacing it

title: ‘Their word is not their bond,’ policy expert slams last minute U.S. trade demands

title: Alcohol ban ‘had its time’ and must end for deal with U.S., says trade advisor
source_description: The alcohol ban imposed in retaliation to Trump’s first round tariffs on Canada’s steel and aluminum, was effective in getting U.S. attention, says trade advisor.

title: Dropping retaliatory U.S. tariffs may ‘lead to a worse outcome,’ for Canada, warns ex-adviser

title: ‘It looks like it’s going to end in tears,’ former diplomat warns ahead of Canada-U.S. tariff deadline

title: Ontario’s lithium race is on. And the first mine could open in two years

title: ‘We’re in for a rocky road’: Trump’s latest tariffs on items like cosmetics and paper create $28B worry for businesses, industry warns

title: This Canadian uranium company is mining without digging to speed production in 2 years
